authority_boundary.f3_owner_scope: source preparation, definition, geometry binding, diff explanation, audit; no solver or GenCase dispatch

gencase_cpu_suggestion.automatic_eos_policy: Preserve official GenCase AutomaticEOS. Generated constants B, h, and native particle mass remain unknown until actual GenCase execution by Root. No invented B/h/nativeMass values, no bitwise equality assertions across DP, and no physical mass normalization.

device_dispatch_policy.runtime_note: Root strict dispatcher binds dynamic live inventory lease to an owned idle GPU (2, 5, 6, or 7). Never hardcode device IDs.

solver_gpu_suggestion.recipe_summary: Symplectic step algorithm, Wendland kernel, CFL 0.05, CoefDtMin 0.005, mDBC no-slip (-mdbc_noslip:1), NoPenetration 1.

post_launch_verification_checks: Verify returncode == 0 and solver completed normally.
Verify exactly 836 typed native frames produced in interval [0, 8.35]s.
Check timestep distribution and audit allDTsMin0 compliance.
Verify fluid particle count is exactly 67,500 with zero excluded particles (PartsOutMax=1 respected, 0 actual lost).
Record actual GenCase B, h, and native particle mass into receipt without post-hoc mass rescaling.
